dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: No news. But perhaps... no news is the best news.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Katya and Kolya... They are children of the House of the Hearth. They value the bonds of family far more than we do.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: If they are still alive, I hope they never come back here.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: I believe that they deserted the Fatui, escaped somewhere safe, and survived. So for me... no news is the best news. I can still believe that.
